message: So there I was, trying to whip up dinner when I accidentally set off the smoke alarm—again. 😅 Cue the family group chat going wild! My daughter was sending me emojis of fire and my husband was asking if we needed to practice our escape plan. It reminded me how important it is to have a plan and to keep those smoke alarms working! Just a little nudge to stay prepared can go a long way. What’s your family’s go-to fire safety tip?
